Subject: Your cheque bounce matter - CC/1854/2019

Dear Mr. Saxena,

Thank you for meeting us on 2 January 2020 about your dispute with M/s Zenith Enterprises. As we understand it, the cheque was dishonoured because the signature did not match. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Thane.

Our advice is to obtain the bank's certificate on the signature mismatch and treat it as a dishonour under the cheque-bounce law. Please collect the bank's certificate on the signature mismatch and the drawer's earlier cheques and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Sharmila Venkatesan
